The '''Im'g'twe Hills''' were an elevated area on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was fought over this area.
